subject.title: Surface Codex final answer candidates in activity

question: Should this PR land as a narrow answer-candidate Activity slice after rebase, or should answer-candidate handling be folded into the broader native Codex progress UX tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80039?
rationale: Current main still lacks this specific answer-candidate Activity behavior, but the requested UX overlaps a broader open product/privacy decision and the branch no longer merges cleanly after Control UI reorganization.

options.title: Rebase and land narrow slice
options.body: Have the contributor rebase onto ui/src/pages/activity and ui/src/pages/chat, then review this as a bounded answer-candidate Activity feature.

options.title: Fold into canonical Codex progress work
options.body: Close or pause this branch and incorporate answer-candidate lifecycle handling into the broader replacement implementation for native Codex progress visibility.

options.title: Do not add this surface
options.body: Reject answer-candidate Activity as a standalone UI concept and leave current final-answer delivery behavior unchanged.

recommendation.title: Rebase and land narrow slice
recommendation.body: Have the contributor rebase onto ui/src/pages/activity and ui/src/pages/chat, then review this as a bounded answer-candidate Activity feature.

likelyOwner.reason: The historical UI stream work and current product-surface decision are closest to the Control UI/Codex progress boundary reflected in prior reviews.
